parameters.command: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const registry = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/data/youtube-upload/config/channels.json", "utf8")); const channels = registry.channels.filter(c => c.enabled).map(c => ({key:c.key, displayName:c.displayName})); const folders = fs.readdirSync("/data/videos", {withFileTypes:true}).filter(entry => entry.isDirectory()).map(entry => entry.name).sort(); process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({channels, folders}));'
